name: Children Harmed by AI Technology Act of 2025
description: Proposed US federal bipartisan legislation requiring AI companion chatbot operators to implement age verification, obtain verifiable parental consent for minor accounts, display pop-up disclosures that the companion is not human, and block sexually explicit or self-harm/suicide content for minor users, enforced by the FTC and state attorneys general.
relationToCloudSecurity: Establishes statutory or regulatory compliance obligations issued by United States Congress (congress.gov) applicable to cloud service providers, data controllers, and digital operators.
relationToAISecurity: Governs data protection, automated decision-making, cybersecurity, or AI system compliance within United States Congress (congress.gov).
